normative_rule: Every event identifier is a non-empty scalar string and is unique.
rationale_or_validity_threat: Malformed or duplicated identifiers make reconstruction non-auditable.
implementation_control: Strict canonical schema validation before normalisation.

normative_rule: Only explicitly supported event types are accepted.
rationale_or_validity_threat: Unknown semantics can be silently misclassified.
implementation_control: Event-type allowlist tied to workflow configuration.

normative_rule: Timestamps are timezone-aware and parseable.
rationale_or_validity_threat: Malformed or local timestamps invalidate durations and ordering.
implementation_control: ISO-8601 timestamp parser with timezone requirement.

normative_rule: Token, cost, duration, attempt, and quality semantic fields have strict non-boolean numeric types and valid ranges.
rationale_or_validity_threat: Permissive coercion can convert bad evidence into plausible metrics.
implementation_control: Semantic-field type and range validation.

normative_rule: Unresolved template placeholders and reversed windows are rejected.
rationale_or_validity_threat: A default or reversed protocol can select the wrong evidence.
implementation_control: Recursive placeholder scan and ordered window validation.

normative_rule: A run starts from exactly one mapped run_started event.
rationale_or_validity_threat: Implicit or duplicate starts make the run window ambiguous.
implementation_control: Configured start-event cardinality gate.

normative_rule: A run ends at exactly one mapped run_completed or run_failed event.
rationale_or_validity_threat: Missing or multiple terminals make duration and status ambiguous.
implementation_control: Terminal cardinality and semantic conflict gate.

normative_rule: Run status is derived from terminal-event semantics, not arbitrary raw status text.
rationale_or_validity_threat: Raw status can conflict with the authoritative lifecycle event.
implementation_control: Terminal event mapping is authoritative; conflicts reject.

normative_rule: The start is first and the terminal is last under timestamp plus source-sequence ordering.
rationale_or_validity_threat: Pre-start, post-terminal, or equal-time later rows can contaminate a run.
implementation_control: Stable source sequence retained as timestamp tie-breaker.

normative_rule: Tool calls are deduplicated by call identifier and retries by step and attempt.
rationale_or_validity_threat: Duplicated observations inflate reliability and tool-use counts.
implementation_control: Set-based run-level aggregation.
expected_result_or_code: one tool call and one retry; critical mutant killed

normative_rule: Token and cost observations are summed once using explicit per-event-increment semantics.
rationale_or_validity_threat: Cumulative counters would be overcounted if interpreted as increments.
implementation_control: Mapped fields require declared aggregation_semantics=per_event_increment.

normative_rule: Every run has one configuration ID, version, and hash.
rationale_or_validity_threat: Within-run drift invalidates attribution.
implementation_control: VC-CONFIG-CONSISTENCY

normative_rule: Every observed configuration matches a manifest-declared expected configuration and required groups are present.
rationale_or_validity_threat: A syntactically valid but fabricated comparator can pass without observed evidence.
implementation_control: Observed identity tuple matched to expected configuration list.

normative_rule: Undeclared capabilities produce null/unsupported values, never zero.
rationale_or_validity_threat: Zero falsely asserts an instrumented absence.
implementation_control: Capability-gated reconstruction and coverage reporting.
expected_result_or_code: null values and supported=false; critical mutant killed

normative_rule: Every requested required signal exposes exact covered and eligible denominators; incomplete safe evidence cannot attain the complete tier.
rationale_or_validity_threat: Treating incomplete telemetry as complete overstates evidence, while rejecting all safe partial evidence hides useful readiness information.
implementation_control: Required-signal coverage gate feeds per-metric status and evidence-tier classification.
expected_result_or_code: complete at N/N; partial or mapping_only with TELEMETRY_REQUIRED_SIGNAL_MISSING

normative_rule: Optional metric coverage exposes observed, included, and missing denominators.
rationale_or_validity_threat: A mean or total without its denominator conceals missingness.
implementation_control: Coverage object emitted beside each optional metric.
expected_result_or_code: partial_observed_sum and explicit n/N; no complete total

normative_rule: Complete totals are withheld unless coverage is complete.
rationale_or_validity_threat: A partial observed sum is not a population total.
implementation_control: Separate total and partial_observed_sum fields.
expected_result_or_code: total when N/N; null total and partial n/N otherwise

normative_rule: Comparator deltas are withheld unless both groups meet the declared coverage gate.
rationale_or_validity_threat: Deltas between differently missing groups are misleading.
implementation_control: Per-group coverage gate before delta calculation.
expected_result_or_code: exact deltas; delta null with withheld reason

normative_rule: Elapsed cycle time and active human effort are distinct constructs.
rationale_or_validity_threat: Agent elapsed time is not labour consumed.
implementation_control: Separate cycle-time and human-effort fields and formula paths.

normative_rule: Labour value requires explicit baseline and agent-side human effort.
rationale_or_validity_threat: Inferring effort from elapsed time overstates benefit.
implementation_control: Economic eligibility gate checks both effort inputs.

normative_rule: Benefit requires completion and business-success or explicitly approved quality evidence.
rationale_or_validity_threat: Technical completion alone is not a business benefit.
implementation_control: Per-run benefit eligibility gate with recorded reason.

normative_rule: Failed runs receive zero benefit and every included run's observed costs reduce portfolio net value.
rationale_or_validity_threat: Excluding failed-run costs biases portfolio value upward.
implementation_control: Benefit and cost eligibility are calculated separately.
expected_result_or_code: zero failed benefit; all-run cost subtraction; critical mutant killed

normative_rule: Portfolio net value is withheld when any included run lacks required cost evidence.
rationale_or_validity_threat: Unknown cost cannot safely be treated as zero.
implementation_control: All-run cost-coverage gate.

normative_rule: Money uses decimal arithmetic and documented rounding.
rationale_or_validity_threat: Binary floating point can create non-reproducible cent values.
implementation_control: Decimal input, summation, and quantization.
expected_result_or_code: exact unrounded ledger; declared presentation rounding

normative_rule: Outputs expose design_claim_ceiling, design_evidence_status, attained_claim_strength, and withheld_reasons.
rationale_or_validity_threat: A label inferred only from a design name overstates evidence.
implementation_control: Evidence-gated claim assessment.
expected_result_or_code: four structured fields; unmet gates listed

normative_rule: Every synthetic evaluation is capped at conformance/readiness evidence.
rationale_or_validity_threat: Synthetic A/B-shaped data do not establish a causal effect.
implementation_control: Deployment-mode cap applied after design ceiling.

normative_rule: anchor_hash_only retains no snapshots; redacted_snapshot retains only allowlisted or masked values.
rationale_or_validity_threat: Evidence retention can reproduce restricted payloads.
implementation_control: Evidence-mode-specific serialization.

normative_rule: Langfuse input/output plaintext and raw value hashes are omitted by default.
rationale_or_validity_threat: Plain SHA-256 of short values enables dictionary linkage.
implementation_control: Strict omission default; keyed HMAC only when explicitly configured and key kept outside bundle.
expected_result_or_code: no bodies or raw hashes; optional hmac_sha256 descriptor only

normative_rule: The entire derived bundle is scanned for declared restricted canaries.
rationale_or_validity_threat: Diagnostics and command captures can leak data even if analytical JSON is masked.
implementation_control: Recursive binary/text canary scan before publication.

normative_rule: Every tier-specific artefact set publishes transactionally; a degraded or blocked rerun cannot retain stale complete artefacts.
rationale_or_validity_threat: Late failure or tier degradation can leave a stale scorecard that looks stronger than current evidence.
implementation_control: Temporary staging plus atomic tier-specific publication and overwrite gate.
expected_result_or_code: complete or partial package; mapping-only onboarding artefacts; blocked diagnostics/readiness only

normative_rule: Source references are logical identifiers rather than absolute paths.
rationale_or_validity_threat: Workspace paths break privacy and cross-root determinism.
implementation_control: Logical source-name derivation at ingestion.
expected_result_or_code: identical analytical artefacts; zero workspace-root strings

normative_rule: verify-package recomputes input, event, raw-line, schema, artefact, and bundle hashes.
rationale_or_validity_threat: A package that only records hashes cannot detect later tampering.
implementation_control: Public verification command and fail-closed mismatch diagnostics.

normative_rule: Analytical outputs are deterministic across output directories.
rationale_or_validity_threat: Nondeterministic provenance undermines audit comparison.
implementation_control: Canonical JSON/CSV ordering and logical artefact names.

normative_rule: Two fixed-epoch builds produce identical distribution hashes.
rationale_or_validity_threat: A build that cannot be reproduced weakens frozen-artefact identity.
implementation_control: SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH build repetition and digest comparison.

normative_rule: Supported camelCase, snake_case, JSON, JSONL, and gzip containers normalise equivalently.
rationale_or_validity_threat: Adapter results should not depend on a supported export representation.
implementation_control: Alias and container-normalisation layer.

normative_rule: An API capture with a non-null pagination cursor is rejected.
rationale_or_validity_threat: Partial pages are not a complete observation population.
implementation_control: Pagination-completeness gate before output publication.

normative_rule: Business completion/failure comes only from an approved status mapping.
rationale_or_validity_threat: Absence of an error is not evidence of business success.
implementation_control: Explicit terminal/root selector and approved mapping.

normative_rule: Configurations, manifests, canonical events, diagnostics, scorecards, packages, and readiness results have machine-validatable schemas.
rationale_or_validity_threat: Undocumented output shape makes independent verification brittle.
implementation_control: Published JSON Schema documents and schema gate.

normative_rule: Every normative requirement links bidirectionally to a passing evidence artefact.
rationale_or_validity_threat: Headline test counts do not establish verification completeness.
implementation_control: Machine-checked requirements matrix.

normative_rule: Thesis-critical branches have 100% coverage and overall coverage reaches 90% line and 85% branch.
rationale_or_validity_threat: Unexecuted decision paths can hide contract violations.
implementation_control: Coverage gate by module and annotated critical branch set.

normative_rule: No non-equivalent critical mutant survives.
rationale_or_validity_threat: Passing tests may merely repeat implementation assumptions.
implementation_control: Predeclared targeted mutation campaign.

normative_rule: Same-author reruns are described only as deterministic repeatability; the current evidence bundle contains no external-review record or binding fields.
rationale_or_validity_threat: Terminology inflation or stale external-review metadata misstates the evidential contribution.
implementation_control: Report-language audit and bundle-structure inspection.
expected_result_or_code: zero prohibited current claims; no supervisor record or binding field

normative_rule: Hashes establish integrity and identity, not authenticity or anonymity.
rationale_or_validity_threat: Cryptographic overclaiming creates a governance validity threat.
implementation_control: Explicit interpretation boundary in protocol/report/package.

normative_rule: A source profile records field paths, types, coverage, formats, and structural counts without retaining raw source values.
rationale_or_validity_threat: Value-bearing profiling can leak enterprise content and obscure whether the mapping assessment is vendor-neutral.
implementation_control: Raw-value-free source-profile validator and published schema.
expected_result_or_code: profile validates with zero raw values; source profile rejected if unsupported properties are supplied

normative_rule: Every requested canonical signal records source paths, transformation class, transformation-test status, semantic status, and approval evidence.
rationale_or_validity_threat: A syntactic field match does not establish shared business meaning.
implementation_control: Vendor-neutral mapping specification and per-signal assessment.

normative_rule: Workflow boundaries, business status, and privacy each require an explicit approval state.
rationale_or_validity_threat: Boundary or outcome ambiguity can convert observations into invalid run or success semantics.
implementation_control: Separate mapping approvals with role and evidence reference.
expected_result_or_code: verified only when approvals complete; MAPPING_APPROVAL_REQUIRED

normative_rule: Mapping friction is reported as a multidimensional profile rather than a universal weighted score.
rationale_or_validity_threat: A single synthetic score would imply unsupported cross-organisation comparability.
implementation_control: Friction artefact exposes signal progress, transformations, iterations, decisions, approvals, issues, reviews, heterogeneity, cycle time, and effort separately.
expected_result_or_code: exact dimensional oracle; no aggregate friction score

normative_rule: Active mapping effort is complete only when every retained activity entry records effort; partial effort is an observed sum with n/N and is never extrapolated.
rationale_or_validity_threat: Self-reported or incomplete effort can be mistaken for total onboarding labour.
implementation_control: Activity-log completeness status and denominator gate.
expected_result_or_code: 45 minutes at 4/4; 35 minutes at 3/4 with null complete total; null/not_recorded without log

normative_rule: Mapping versions, iterations, issue states, decisions, approvals, and stakeholder dependencies remain auditable dimensions.
rationale_or_validity_threat: Hidden iteration and decision work understates onboarding friction.
implementation_control: Version-aware activity log and issue register.
expected_result_or_code: two versions and exact activity/issue counts

normative_rule: The attained tier is one of blocked, mapping_only, partial, or complete and is evaluated independently from design claim strength.
rationale_or_validity_threat: Telemetry completeness can otherwise be confused with causal or external validity.
implementation_control: Separate readiness classifier and claim assessment.
expected_result_or_code: exact tier; synthetic claim remains conformance_readiness

normative_rule: Unsafe privacy, integrity, identity, aggregation, pagination, or population assignment failures block the bundle.
rationale_or_validity_threat: Degraded analytics must not weaken non-negotiable safety or semantic controls.
implementation_control: Bundle-scoped blockers publish only privacy-scanned diagnostics and readiness.

normative_rule: Safe profiling with unverified mapping or workflow semantics attains mapping_only and publishes no analytical scorecard.
rationale_or_validity_threat: Analytics over unresolved semantics create false precision.
implementation_control: Mapping-readiness gate before analytical publication.
expected_result_or_code: mapping_only; onboarding and readiness artefacts only

normative_rule: At least one valid metric family with incomplete requested evidence attains partial and publishes exact per-metric denominators.
rationale_or_validity_threat: All-or-nothing rejection hides usable bounded evidence during early adoption.
implementation_control: Per-family status evaluation and partial-tier publication.
expected_result_or_code: partial; valid scorecard values labelled with n/N

normative_rule: Only full requested telemetry, satisfied design preconditions, verified required mapping, and zero quarantine attain complete.
rationale_or_validity_threat: Calling bounded evidence complete overstates readiness.
implementation_control: Complete-tier conjunction with legacy complete minimum preserved when policy is absent.
expected_result_or_code: complete only under all preconditions; legacy minimum remains complete

normative_rule: Once event and run identities are trustworthy, run-local boundary, configuration, or missing-signal anomalies quarantine the affected run without contaminating retained runs.
rationale_or_validity_threat: One local defect should not erase trustworthy evidence, but must remain visible in the source population denominator.
implementation_control: Run-local reconstruction isolation and quarantine register.
expected_result_or_code: one quarantined run; valid runs retained; population denominator includes all source runs

normative_rule: Every metric family is independently available, partial, withheld, or unsupported and carries covered, eligible, and population denominators.
rationale_or_validity_threat: A global readiness label cannot express metric-specific missingness or preconditions.
implementation_control: Per-metric availability classifier with independent comparator, economic, quality, cost, duration, and reliability gates.
expected_result_or_code: exact independent statuses and denominators; missing values never zero

normative_rule: Langfuse preparation emits the common vendor-neutral source profile and mapping assessment and accepts the same optional activity log.
rationale_or_validity_threat: A vendor-specific adapter can hide the actual mapping and approval work.
implementation_control: Adapter delegates onboarding assessment to the shared mapping engine.
expected_result_or_code: common artefacts emitted; effort remains null without complete log

normative_rule: Source profiles, mapping specifications, mapping activities, mapping assessments, friction summaries, and evaluation readiness have machine-validatable schemas.
rationale_or_validity_threat: A first-class onboarding layer requires a stable public contract.
implementation_control: Published JSON Schema documents and generated-output schema gate.
expected_result_or_code: all onboarding and tier schemas validate
